methodology.implemented: Actual functional path; Partial counts as implemented breadth, never as complete. Parsing alone does not count.
methodology.validated: Mapped targeted passing assertions for a contract subset, not end-to-end Bedrock equivalence. Query/math leaves credited only after explicit runtime/numerical assertions were reviewed.
methodology.substantially_complete: Requires spec-edge-case and execution/rendering parity evidence. No audited contract currently certified at that bar; this is a conservative verified lower bound, not proof all behavior is wrong.
methodology.counting: Each explicit capability/component/query/math row counts once. Core estimate excludes query/math leaves to prevent query-heavy denominator distortion. Skin packs, undocumented encrypted distribution contracts and Crossrock-specific persistence excluded. Schema-field appendix not counted (nested fields/versions duplicate contracts). Unsupported and Unknown remain in denominator.
methodology.scope_limit: Broad official-document inventory, not a proof that every historical/preview schema leaf is exhaustively verified. Uncertified schema leaves are explicitly Unknown. No global feature-complete claim is justified.
